name: JBO Communications
summary: Sydney VoIP/telco provider (JBO Communications Pty Ltd, ACN 089 726 358; tele-housing, SIP/IAX termination); defunct ~2011-13.

events.details: Defunct. Site live to early 2016, broken by Oct 2016, company ABN cancelled Aug 2017 — c. 2016 as proposed (the c. 2011-13 entry is too early).

refs.label: Full telco site live 9 Jan 2016 (identical content served since late 2014).
By 7-8 Oct 2016 the site only emitted broken-Joomla SQL errors (final captures 8 Oct 2016); no later captures and domain unreachable in 2026.
Company ABN cancelled 30 Aug 2017, ten months after the site died.
